correctness.rationale: The graph definition and equivalent face predicate are explicit. Exhaustive enumeration of all 2^16-1 nonempty subsets returns 6812 simplices. The stagewise 3400-pair matching passes a complete 35104-incidence oriented-Hasse DAG check, leaving one 0-, one 4-, four 5- and six 6-cells. Exact signed boundary matrices satisfy d5*d6=0; d5 has a unit pivot and d6 has a -1 maximal 3x3 minor, proving primitive rank three and three free degree-six classes. The high-dimensional CW attaching-map groups are free degree lattices, giving the integral homotopy wedge. An independent full-chain mod-two reduction reproduces the Betti vector. Exhaustive 96-aut Lefschetz traces give character average 0 and squared norm 1, so irreducibility, action-kernel and quotient conclusions follow without a field experiment being substituted for an integral proof.

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is the unique 16-vertex cubic symmetric graph and the natural incidence graph of an eight-point configuration. The exact two-independence homotopy type, distinct from its published ordinary independence type, makes a topological comparison meaningful. Its full 96-element action realizes a three-dimensional absolutely irreducible rational homology character with zero invariants, explaining why all three top classes disappear rationally under symmetry quotient. This full-character structural refinement and quotient behavior are not textbook face-count deductions or arbitrary parameter slices.
